notes: Five-tool dev harness (Jupyter notebook, Vim plugin, gawk, jq, shell orchestrator). Several independent deliverables, each exercised by the verifier on genuinely different hidden inputs: awk top-k across frames including ties/short frames/blank and header-only inputs, jq record transforms (empty tags, all-dropped, ordering), Vim plugin layout introspection in fresh headless sessions with varying window counts, and a shell orchestrator whose subset mode must be awk-only via PATH (python forbidden). Difficulty driven by cross-tool breadth, exact-output correctness, and hidden-case generalization; the awk medium/Vim medium floors set the bucket to medium.
